decisions.reason: This core LED track spotlight has kept its own page for two years and fits the modular system range, so a lighting firm would normally keep it for several years.
The LED ceiling luminaire has stayed prominently presented since 2023 and is close to the established offer, so dropping it this early is unlikely.
The flexible LED spotlight launched only in 2024, has its own page and fits the core range, so it is too early to drop.
The multi-outlet canopy is a system accessory that supports the modular luminaire offering and dealer installations, so it is likely to stay.
The low-voltage canopy complements the modular systems and has its own page, so it should stay in the range.
The website only mentions it rather than giving it its own page, which suggests less prominence, but as a recent track system addition it is still likely to be kept.
